notes.title: In-Game Puzzle Hints and Character Sprites Update
notes.content:
After the game released, we received some really good feedback and we decided to make some changes to make the experience better.

We have implemented In-game hints to help solving puzzles. Now in a lot of puzzles, when you open the puzzle interface, you will see a lightbulb icon on the left. Click on that icon and you can get some insights on how to solve that puzzle.

We have also updated character sprites and some of the CGs. We changed the previous thick black lines to color lines and soften the character art in general, so they look better and blend with the background better.

We hope you enjoy the update. Thank you!
